name: KiCad PR Visual Diff

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'Hardware/**/*.kicad_pcb'
      - 'Hardware/**/*.kicad_sch'

jobs:
  kiri-diff:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      pull-requests: write # Allows the bot to post a comment
      contents: write      # Allows the bot to temporarily host images
      
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0  # Crucial: Grabs both your old and new commit history

      - name: Run Kiri KiCad Diff Action
        uses: usa-reddragon/kiri-github-action@v1
        with:
          project-file: Hardware/BMS_V4.kicad_pro
